**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Unsupported model binding: {name}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Use `model:value` only on `<textarea>`, `<select>` or `<input type="text|search|email|url|tel|password">` with a static type, and `model:checked` only on `<input type="checkbox">`; the value must be a signal identifier or member (`model:value={name}`).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
declare const v: any;
export const A = () => <div model:value={v} />;
```

```tsx prefer
declare const v: any;
export const A = () => <input type="text" model:value={v} />;
```
